tasks.title: Write copy for the mining button guide panel
tasks.description:

KEYBOARD:
  • SPACE — hold to fire mining laser at surface deposits
  • D — deploy a drone to collect dark subsurface deposits (when unlocked)
  • RETURN/ENTER — end run and open mission debrief

TOUCH (on-screen buttons):
  • FIRE button (large, bottom-centre) — hold to mine
  • DRONE button — tap while over a dark deposit
  • RETURN button (top-right) — end run

Also needs: brief explanation of surface (orange) vs subsurface (dark) deposits, and what the fuel/heat/beam gauges mean in one sentence each.

The '? Guide' button is visible in the top-right corner of the mining minigame screen. The shell (what the player sees before entering the game) in landscape / active-game mode:

tasks.title: Write homepage headline and subhead variants
tasks.description:
Need 4–5 headline + subhead pairs for the homepage hero. The client turns real NASA data into games that teach real science.

Avoid:
  • 'Gamifying science' (cliché)
  • 'Learn by playing' (feels educational, not exciting)
  • Anything with 'reimagine' or 'transforming'

Aim for: something that makes you want to know more. The headline should have tension — a gap between what you expect games to be and what this is.
